newsitem.title: UK: LME copper, aluminium hold price gains in evening.
newsitem.headline: LME copper, aluminium hold price gains in evening.

text.p: Copper and aluminium prices held their gains and nickel firmed a little during London Metal Exchange evening trading on Thursday.
Business was fairly quiet on the post-kerb and at 1900 GMT copper was indicated at $2,270/$2,274 barely firmer with aluminium a shade easier at $1,605/$1,608.
Aluminium alloy also eased with the primary coming back $10/$5 to $1,510/$1,525.
Nickel was about $10 firmer at $7,220/$7,250 after earlier technical trading helped prices get over $7,200.
